CONCURRENT_EVENTS: Timeout/unknown may coexist with cleanup, capture, close, durability and audit errors; first cause immutable
MUTUAL_EXCLUSIVITY: Definite rejected/confirmed service start and known/unknown final exit are alternative primary outcomes, not simultaneous totals

PRIMARY_COUNTS.NORMAL_VS_FAILURE: Successful and definitely rejected service start alternatives; confirmed and unknown final exit alternatives. Primary error does not forbid concurrent later cleanup/audit errors.

PRIMARY_STATE_BOUNDS.CONDITION: Only one exact manager invocation; confirmed start incompatible with definite rejected start
Definite independent no-service rejection only; ambiguous creation belongs UNKNOWN
One terminal service identity verdict; subsequent observation failures may still occur
One immutable primary cause; later stop/audit errors remain secondary
One primary unresolved outcome classification, not every later unknown witness
One final outcome state; does not justify one physical audit write

PRIMARY_COUNTS.TIMEOUT_GAP: Several distinct deadline/cleanup observations can follow an earlier first failure. Exact timer/stop/query/finalization event handling is unsealed; one launch is not one timeout witness.

RECOVERY: Readonly reconcile, no consumed key deletion, no recovered/reusable launch token

RETAINED_MODEL.AUDIT_PUBLICATION_OCCURRENCES: State slot does not automatically bound physical/publication attempts or error witnesses; must derive exact implementation topology
